title: Repair the blind-pack masking instrument (redaction-token-count leak)
successor_note: Predecessor was killed at the reading stage and left nothing on disk but this file. Resumed from scratch after reading RULES.md, RI-MTH03, JUDGEMENT-judge-prose-r4-m5.md and tools/prose/build-r2-packs.mjs.
next_step: write tools/blind/leakcheck.mjs (battery + gate + self-test), then tools/blind/mask-text.mjs (renaming masker), then rewire the builder
decisions: RULING-1 (reversible): replace redaction with RE-NAMING. No [NAME-n] token exists in the artifact, so the count channel is removed rather than balanced. Cost accepted: the text is altered, not merely redacted.
RULING-2 (reversible): pairing is matched on proper-noun DENSITY as well as word count, with a hard tolerance; a trial with no partner inside tolerance is dropped rather than shipped.

RULING-3: r4 is closed as superseded rather than patched. Three judges have read it and it contains a plaintext answer key; a re-judged pack is a different object. A clean r5 is built by the fixed builder.
RULING-4: chance baseline is 1-in-8 (3 effective trials, one per register), not 1-in-270.
notes: Instrument repair only. Do NOT re-judge prose.
